correctness.rationale: The frozen result fixes the exact lattice cell graph and action by r(i,j)=(-j,i+j),s(i,j)=(j,i). Independently constructed all 24 dual vertices and 30 edges, exhaustively enumerated 20 perfect-matching facets and all 66369 nonempty faces. Reimplemented greedy lexicographic vertex-edge toggling, yielding 33183 matched pairs and critical cells in dimensions 0,3,3; performed complete directed Hasse acyclicity check. Three cells and no 1/2 cells give S^3 vee S^3 by Forman discrete Morse. For every one of 12 dihedral symmetries independently summed signed orientation traces of all stabilized faces; obtained homology character rotations (2,0,2,0,2,0) and reflections (0,-2,0,-2,0,-2). Rational D6 character theory yields alpha+beta. Rational transfer yields quotient homology invariants. These checks are exhaustive for this finite complex, not a family theorem or integral equivariant splitting.
residual_risks: Only rational representation splitting and rational quotient homology are concluded, not integral D6-lattice splitting, integral quotient acyclicity or Bredon homology.
